description: This circular walk takes you from Bradwell to Castleton in Derbyshire. It runs for just under 6 miles along a series of local footpaths and quiet country lanes. The opening leg starts in Bradwell and follows a direct route to Castleton pass the Hope Cement Works, the large limestone quarry and Pin Dale. You'll then return on a quiet country lane with some fine views over the surrounding Peak District countryside.
